## Plan: ATS Skills Title Split

Implement the change in a new linked worktree and branch for the cv-builder repo, then split skills section title handling so ATS-targeted outputs always render SKILLS while human-target outputs continue to use the user-selected title. Reuse the existing session-scoped customization flow, avoid any writes to Master_CV_Data.json, and cover the split with targeted regression tests.

**Steps**
1. Phase 1: Isolate the work in a new linked git worktree under /Users/warnes/src/cv-builder/worktrees and create a dedicated branch there. Recommended naming: worktree path /Users/warnes/src/cv-builder/worktrees/ats-skills-title and branch name fix/ats-skills-title. This blocks all later steps.
2. Phase 2: Trace the current title flow in generation code and preserve the session-only customization contract. Update the plan of record for the implementation to keep title decisions inside the generation customizations path rather than the master data model. This depends on 1.
3. Phase 3: Update ATS generation paths so ATS-targeted output always uses SKILLS regardless of any user-provided human title. This includes the ATS DOCX generator in the orchestrator and the ATS/plaintext section inside the shared HTML template. This depends on 2.
4. Phase 4: Update human-target generation paths so the user-specified title remains limited to visual human output, including the non-ATS HTML section and any PDF output derived from that HTML, plus the human DOCX generator if it already supports or should support the same customization source. This depends on 2 and can be implemented alongside 3 once the title-source seam is chosen.
5. Phase 5: If current code lacks a clean separation between ATS and human title values, introduce the smallest session-scoped interface needed in the customization or prepared-template data flow so templates and generators can consume distinct ATS versus human skills titles without changing stored master CV data. This depends on 2 and may be done in parallel with 3 and 4 as part of the same refactor.
6. Phase 6: Add or update regression tests that verify ATS outputs always contain SKILLS and human outputs continue to use the selected human-facing title. Prioritize focused tests around the orchestrator/template seam rather than broad end-to-end coverage first. This depends on 3 through 5.
